dedupe_keys.name: anfr openbarres crowdsourced mobile reception measurements

description: This dataset publishes measurements of mobile network reception taken by users of OpenBarres, the smartphone application of the French spectrum agency ANFR, while they move around France. Each measurement can include the location, the mobile technology in use (2G, 3G, 4G or 5G), the operator and indicators of received signal strength and quality, as far as each user chose to share them; ANFR releases them as open data on a voluntary basis. Coverage: France, point measurements, daily updates from 17 September 2026 when the dataset opened. Format and access: a ZIP archive of CSV files (about 4 MB at first) on data.gouv.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: very new, so the series is short; crowdsourced samples cluster where users are and depend on handset models; the fields present vary between measurements. Simulation uses: measured reception to validate modelled coverage maps and propagation models, and service performance baselines before and after hazard events. Related records: Arcep Mon Réseau Mobile gives operator coverage maps and field campaigns, and ANFR mobile network stations give the sites.
